features.name: llvm-jit
features.reason: JIT is not needed for CRUD workloads and drags in LLVM.
features.behaviorImpact: jit setting has no effect; queries are never JIT-compiled.
features.bootstrapImpact: None: JIT is off by default in the build.

features.name: icu
features.reason: Both targets use the builtin locale provider (C.UTF-8) so results match; ICU data is large.
features.behaviorImpact: No ICU collations; ORDER BY on text follows the builtin C.UTF-8 rules.
features.bootstrapImpact: initdb must be run with --locale-provider=builtin; the default provider would try ICU.

features.name: xml
features.reason: XML type and functions are outside the required SQL profile.
features.behaviorImpact: xml type operations raise 'not supported' errors.
features.bootstrapImpact: None; the xml type is still declared in the catalogs.

features.name: xslt
features.reason: Only used by contrib/xml2, which is not built.
features.behaviorImpact: None for the supported profile.

features.name: plpython
features.reason: Large external runtime, no use in the profile.
features.behaviorImpact: CREATE EXTENSION plpython3u fails with a clear error.

features.name: plperl
features.reason: Large external runtime, no use in the profile.
features.behaviorImpact: CREATE EXTENSION plperl fails with a clear error.

features.name: pltcl
features.reason: Large external runtime, no use in the profile.
features.behaviorImpact: CREATE EXTENSION pltcl fails with a clear error.

features.name: ldap
features.reason: Directory authentication is out of scope; SCRAM-SHA-256 is the auth method.
features.behaviorImpact: pg_hba.conf entries using ldap are rejected at load.

features.name: gssapi
features.reason: Kerberos is out of scope.
features.behaviorImpact: gss auth and encryption unavailable.

features.name: pam
features.reason: No PAM in a FROM scratch image.
features.behaviorImpact: pam auth unavailable.

features.name: bsd-auth
features.reason: BSD-only authentication.
features.behaviorImpact: bsd auth unavailable.

features.name: selinux
features.reason: Needs libselinux; not applicable in a scratch container.
features.behaviorImpact: sepgsql unavailable.

features.name: bonjour
features.reason: macOS service discovery.
features.behaviorImpact: None.

features.name: systemd
features.reason: No init system in the target image; shutdown is by signal.
features.behaviorImpact: No sd_notify readiness message.

features.name: readline
features.reason: Only psql line editing uses it; psql is not part of the runtime image.
features.behaviorImpact: psql built here (if any) has no line editing or history.
features.bootstrapImpact: None; initdb and the server do not use readline.

features.name: openssl-tls
features.reason: First native profile has TLS off (isolated or local network); SCRAM-SHA-256 does not need OpenSSL.
features.behaviorImpact: ssl=on is rejected; transport is not encrypted; password hashing and SCRAM still work.
features.bootstrapImpact: None. A separate TLS profile may be added later with its own measurements.

features.name: zlib
features.reason: The server uses zlib only for gzip base backups; pg_dump (the only reason it was kept) is an admin tool built separately with its own zlib, not part of the runtime image.
features.behaviorImpact: BASE_BACKUP with gzip compression is unavailable in the static server; pg_dump -Fc is unaffected (dynamic reference build).

features.name: lz4
features.reason: TOAST and WAL compression default to pglz; LZ4 is an optional extra.
features.behaviorImpact: default_toast_compression=lz4 and wal_compression=lz4 are rejected; large values still work through pglz.
features.sizeImpact: pending measurement (CDB-10); re-evaluate against the real benefit

features.name: zstd
features.reason: Optional compression for WAL and pg_dump; not needed for the profile.
features.behaviorImpact: wal_compression=zstd and pg_dump zstd are unavailable.
features.sizeImpact: pending measurement (CDB-10); re-evaluate against the real benefit

features.name: uuid-ossp
features.reason: gen_random_uuid() is built in since PostgreSQL 13; the extension is not needed.
features.behaviorImpact: uuid_generate_v1/v4 from uuid-ossp unavailable; gen_random_uuid() works.

features.name: liburing
features.reason: io_uring needs liburing and kernel support; the default I/O method is enough.
features.behaviorImpact: io_method=io_uring is rejected; worker or sync I/O is used.

features.name: libnuma
features.reason: NUMA tuning is out of scope.
features.behaviorImpact: pg_numa functions unavailable.

features.name: libcurl
features.reason: Only used for OAuth validators.
features.behaviorImpact: OAuth authentication unavailable.

features.name: nls
features.reason: Message translations are not needed; messages are English.
features.behaviorImpact: Server messages are English only.

features.name: debug-and-test-builds
features.reason: Debug, assertion, profiling and test hooks change size and behavior; symbols are kept outside the runtime instead.
features.behaviorImpact: No assertions; production behavior.

features.name: plpgsql
features.reason: Standard bootstrap (initdb, information_schema, system views and extensions) relies on it; the FK machinery does not, but removing it needs coordinated initdb, SQL and catalog changes.
features.behaviorImpact: CREATE FUNCTION ... LANGUAGE plpgsql available.
features.bootstrapImpact: Required by default bootstrap; possible later removal is a separate measured change.

features.name: snowball
features.reason: Default text search configurations are created at bootstrap from the Snowball dictionaries. Only the English stemmer, stop-word list and configuration are kept (patch 0004); the other 28 languages are removed.
features.behaviorImpact: Text search configurations: english and simple. Other languages are not available.
features.bootstrapImpact: initdb creates the english configuration only (snowball_create.sql generated for one language).
features.sizeImpact: about 754,000 bytes of postgres (measured: ospie 8,329,304 -> min1 7,575,640)

features.name: contrib
features.reason: No contrib package is part of the profile; SQL-only extensions are assessed individually.
features.behaviorImpact: No contrib extensions (pgcrypto, pg_trgm, ...).

features.name: scram-sha-256
features.reason: Required password authentication method of the first native profile; implemented in core, independent of OpenSSL.
features.behaviorImpact: SCRAM-SHA-256 login with right and wrong password.
